# One probe per line: <class> <grep -E pattern>, or `find <pattern>` to list matching class files.
# CI prints the matching `javap -p` lines as notices, so Minecraft API differences between versions
# can be checked without a local game jar. Notices are cut off around 4 KB, so keep patterns narrow.
